entities.summary: Estadio Municipal de El Plantío is a stadium in Burgos, Spain. It is currently used for football matches and is the home stadium of Burgos CF. The stadium holds 12,194 spectators. The construction of the stadium started on June 22, 1963, a few months after the project presentation.
